atoms.text: David Attenborough is known for making lots of documentaries about the world’s diverse wildlife. Through his documentaries, he has raised awareness about the impact of humans on animals and the environment.

David is an ambassador for multiple organisations that conserve the planet’s wildlife. For example, he has donated lots of money to campaigns that build protected areas within rainforests in Borneo and Ecuador.

atoms.b: Dr Jane Goodall is a world-famous ((++zoologist astronaut)) and conservationist known for her research on chimpanzees.
Unlike other scientists, she named the chimpanzees instead of numbering them. She believed that they had ((++feelings schools)) like human beings and treated them with respect and kindness.

On one of her research trips, Dr Jane Goodall flew in a small ((++plane boat)) over a national park in Tanzania and witnessed the devastating impact of ((++deforestation overfishing)) on the habitats of chimpanzees.
In response to this, Jane set up refuges for ((++chimps polar_bears)) and founded the Jane Goodall Institute, a global ((++conservation fossil_fuel)) organisation.

atoms.b: I write books and make documentaries about the ocean to help ((++raise lose)) awareness. I am also the founder of Mission Blue.

Mission Blue is an organisation that aims to protect the ocean from threats like ((++climate_change swimming)) and overfishing. One of our main achievements is establishing ((++protected dangerous)) marine areas, which we call Hope Spots.
Thank you for all of your efforts to ((++conserve endanger)) our oceans!
